<div style="margin:0 5px">Ores are mined from the rocks that spawn on every floor and can be [[Craft|crafted]] into Bars. They can also be [[Sell|sold]] for [[File:Gold Coin.png|16x16px]] Gold Coins to allow for purchasing of [[upgrades]] or [[File:Drone Point.png|16x16px]] [[Drones|Drone Points]]. Rock's health and experience given when destroyed depends on the type of ore and it's modifiers.
</div></div>

{{clear|left}}
==Ore Upgrades==
{{See also|Stats#Ore}}
You can improve Ores by increasing related stats:
* [[Stats#tabber-Triple_Rock_Chance|Triple Rock Chance]] - Provides a chance for ore rock to spawn as a [[#TripleRock|triple]] instead of regular one
* [[Stats#tabber-Ore_Sell_Price_Multiplier|Ore Sell Price Multiplier]] - Increases amount of coins obtained when [[Ores#Selling ores|selling ores]]
* [[Stats#tabber-Ore_Income_Multiplier|Ore Income Multiplier]] - Increases amount of ores obtained (base x2)
* [[Stats#tabber-Golden_Ore_Chance|Golden Ore Chance]] - Provides a chance for ore to spawn as [[#GoldenOre|Golden variant]]
* [[Stats#tabber-Golden_Ore_Multiplier|Golden Ore Multiplier]] - Increases the amount of ores received from golden ores (base x3)
* [[Stats#tabber-Rainbow_Ore_Chance|Rainbow Ore Chance]] - Provides a chance for ore to spawn as [[#RainbowOre|Rainbow variant]]
* [[Stats#tabber-Rainbow_Ore_Multiplier|Rainbow Ore Multiplier]] - Increases the amount of ores received from rainbow ores

==Ore marks==
Some bombs, items and certain stats apply effects that marks ores in particular way. Marked ore obtains specific bonus depending on the source of the mark. All ores can be only marked once by every effect (so the same effect applied multiple times does not stack). These effects are shown as an icon next to the ore. Certain [[challenges]] require the usage of those effects to be completed, for example Extreme challenge 22 - "Mine 222.22k Golden Ores".

==Selling ores==
{{See also|Sell}}
[[Sell|Selling ores]] allows to earn [[File:Gold Coin.png|16x16px]] Gold Coins which can be used for buying different upgrades and [[File:Drone Point.png|16x16px]] [[Drones|Drone Points]]. It is worth keeping in mind that the [[Drones#midasDrone|Midas Drone Suit]] provides alternative way of earning coins which does not involve selling ores which can be used to [[Craft|craft]] bars.

==Modifiers==
Starting at World 2 all of the Ores receive a modifier. That modifier can either buff ore's stats, grant it immunity to certain type of damage and even debuff other game stats, for example: decrease golden floor chance or decrease the game speed.
